# Input

Fixes for key and mouse binds.

- Swap hands on a mouse button: `MouseHandSwapUIController` passes the bind on to the game when the cursor is over
  the HUD, where the engine keeps mouse binds from it. In `Resources/keybinds.yml`, the mapping rotate bind sorts
  last on middle mouse so it can't swallow the click, and Point lets the plain middle mouse binds through so the
  swap still works with Shift (walk) held.
